name: Notification inbox
summary: A notifications panel with All and Mentions tabs, unread dots, Today and Earlier groups, and one inline action such as Approve or View.
use: for a work app's notifications and mentions
a11y: Tabs follow the tab pattern with arrow keys; groups are labelled lists; Approve and View are real buttons and the result is shown as text. Placement as a popover is the project's.

use_when: a bell-icon popover or side panel where some notifications can be acted on in place, such as approving a request
avoid_when: a short message about something that just happened: use toast-stack
a running history of changes to one record: use activity-feed or audit-log
a warning that applies to the whole page: use alert-banners

parts.name: tabs
parts.what: one filter tab, with an optional unread count

parts.name: groups
parts.what: a time group heading such as Today or Earlier

parts.name: rows
parts.what: one notification: unread dot, avatar, line, optional quote, time and source, optional actions

parts.name: avatar
parts.what: the sender's photo, or an icon for system notices

parts.name: line
parts.what: what happened, with names and items in bold

parts.name: quote
parts.what: the quoted text of a mention

parts.name: meta
parts.what: time and where it came from, separated by dots

parts.name: actions
parts.what: one or two inline buttons such as Approve or View

parts.name: done
parts.what: the result line that replaces the actions after approving

parts.name: footer
parts.what: a link-style button to notification settings

empty.how: when a tab has nothing, the groups hide but no message shows; add an empty-state line ('No mentions yet') in the panel

loading.how: show three rows with a muted circle for the avatar and two muted bars for the line and time

error.how: if notifications fail to load, show an alert-banners line inside the panel with a retry button; if approving fails, put the actions back and show a toast-stack message

disabled.how: while an approval is sending, set disabled on that row's buttons

overflow.how: the panel grows with its content; give the tab panel a max height and overflow-y: auto so the header and footer stay put

long_text.how: the text column can shrink, so long lines and quotes wrap under each other beside the avatar

keyboard: Tab reaches Mark all read, the selected tab, each notification row, its buttons, and Notification settings
Left and Right arrows move between the All and Mentions tabs and filter the list; only the selected tab is in the Tab order
Enter or Space on Approve marks it approved and shows the result line; Enter on a row itself does nothing
